name: Prior Authorization — MRI Brain with Contrast
description: Prior auth denial for MRI brain. Patient has documented neurological symptoms. Strong appeal basis.

denial.denialLetterText:
Anthem BlueCross
Claims Adjudication Department

DATE: February 3, 2026

RE: Denial of Claim — 70553 (MRI brain with contrast)

Dear Provider,

This letter is to inform you that the claim submitted for the above-referenced service has been denied.

DENIAL REASON: CO197 — Precertification/authorization/notification/pre-treatment absent

PAYER STATEMENT: Precertification was not obtained prior to service delivery. Retroactive authorization may be considered with supporting clinical documentation.

PROCEDURE: 70553 — MRI brain with contrast
DIAGNOSIS: G43.909 — Migraine, unspecified, not intractable

APPEAL RIGHTS: You have the right to appeal this denial within 120 days of the date of this notice.

APPEAL DEADLINE: June 3, 2026

Sincerely,
Claims Adjudication Department
Anthem BlueCross
